oss: Same model, same list price on Fireworks and the maker's own API. Azure's Fireworks-hosted GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash cost +25%.
Bedrock and Vertex trail a generation: GLM 5 / 5.2, DeepSeek V3.2, Kimi K2.x. Neither has Kimi K3 on Vertex, GLM 5.3 or DeepSeek V4.
DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731): $0.14 / $0.28 on Databricks vs $0.22 / $0.66 Fireworks and $0.44 / $1.32 Azure.
Watch-outs priced below Databricks: Llama 4 Maverick (Bedrock, Azure, Vertex), gpt-oss-120b on Vertex, Gemma 3 12B on Bedrock, Alibaba Global-scope Qwen / GLM / Kimi.
APAC residency: Bedrock in-region Tokyo is +20% on OSS; Databricks regional processing is +10% on ⌖ models.
anthropic: List-price parity everywhere: Databricks, Bedrock global, Vertex global and Microsoft Foundry all charge Anthropic's rates.
Regional / data-residency endpoints are +10% on Bedrock, Vertex and Databricks (⌖); Anthropic's US-only inference is ×1.1.
Microsoft Foundry deploys Claude only from US or Sweden Central resources, with no APAC region. Vertex offers asia-east1 (Taiwan) and asia-southeast1 regional endpoints.
On Databricks, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 run in-region in Singapore / Tokyo; Opus, Fable and Sonnet 5 use cross-geo routing.
openai: List-price parity on Databricks, Azure Global Standard and Bedrock Global cross-region; in-region / Data Zone tiers are +10% on Azure and Bedrock.
Bedrock sells GPT-6 and GPT-5.x (GPT-6 Sol / Luna since 22 Sep 2026) and charges a 30-minute cache write. GPT-5.5 there is in-region only, at +10%. Not on Vertex.

APAC: GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 on Databricks are US-region only. Bedrock serves GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 to Tokyo, Singapore and Taipei via global cross-region. Azure has no Hong Kong or Singapore region for them.
GPT-5.6 Sol promo ends 21 Nov 2026, then $5 / $30 on every platform.
google: Databricks matches Google today: a 20% promo on Gemini Pro runs to 31 Jan 2027, then Databricks lists +25% ($2.50 / $15.00).
Flash intro pricing (50% off) ends 31 Dec 2026 everywhere, then $1.50 / $7.50.
Only Databricks and Vertex sell Gemini, not Bedrock, Azure or Alibaba.
